column1: # LedgerFlow OWASP ZAP Baseline Rule Configuration (SEC-SCAN-1)
# Every non-default rule below documents why it is downgraded for the local CI loopback target.
# The CI baseline scan targets http://127.0.0.1:3000 without local TLS termination; RFC 6797
# specifies HSTS applies over HTTPS, which is enforced at the edge (vercel.json + Helmet HSTS).
# Tracked under S-23 staged CSP rollout: script-src already blocks unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval,
# while style-src retains 'unsafe-inline' until inline React style attributes are eliminated.
# First-party payment/banking SDKs (https://js.stripe.com and https://cdn.plaid.com) are
# intentionally loaded by billing/bank-sync views and pinned in CSP script-src.
